fix.description: Format and lint everything, applying automatic fixes

check.description: Check code formatting and lint issues, without changing any files

package.description: Build zip files for submission to the Chrome and Firefox stores. The output is in dist/

write-firefox-manifest.description: Replace manifest.json with a Firefox-compatible version, for development

install-hooks.description: Enable the git hooks in .githooks, e.g. the pre-push hook which runs check
